text:
incident-bot: PAGER — hosted inference us-west-2-a: external agent_exec queue saturating, fn-invoke rate x6, structured-output marshal errors increasing. Paging eng-oncall :telephone_receiver:

alex: oncall here, pulling up dashboards and logs.

sam: linked logs -> https://logs.redwood/prod/us-west-2-a?q=agent_exec+503. Proxy returning 503s, backlog growing in action-proxy.

jin: sounds like external_action_exec path is the hot path. Can we gate it and force a text-only fallback while we stabilize?

maria: I can push a quick config patch to mute external execs for lower-tier plans and strip structured output on new requests. Will do canary then roll.

maria: patch I'm about to apply (canary 2 hosts):

```
# gate external exec and enforce text-only fallback for free/low-tier
curl -X POST https://control-plane.redwood/api/v1/configs/patch \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OP_PATCH' \ 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ 
  -d '{"changes": [{"route":"/v1/actions/exec","scope":"free-tier","op":"disable"},{"route":"/v1/generate","headless_fallback":"text-only","scope":"free-tier"}]}'
```

alex: thanks — please add a quick customer impact note for CS and a link to rollback steps. Tag me when canary is healthy. :white_check_mark:

laura: creating CS ticket and slack comms draft (cs-alerts). I'll send on approval.

deploy-bot: config-rollout: canary -> hosts [canary-2] started by maria (patch id: cfg-1723456789-a).

sam: metrics: after gating canary hosts, agent_exec queue depth down ~68% on those hosts, 503s dropped from 12% -> 1.8%. Latency p50 for text generation down 120ms.

jin: great. Recommend we also apply quota shaping to new free-tier requests and throttle function/toolcall tokens for the next 30m.

maria: applying global rate limit for scope free-tier: 0.3 rps per tenant and trimming toolcall payloads. Rollout to all edge nodes in 60s.

```
# temp rate-limit rule (applied via routing engine)
routectl create-rate-limit --route=/v1/actions/exec --scope=free-tier --rps=0.3 --duration=30m
routectl set-response-transform --route=/v1/generate --mode=strip-structured --scope=free-tier
```

deploy-bot: config-rollout: global rate-limit & transform -> started (progress 0/12 nodes).

sam: progress update: 7/12 nodes applied, overall invoke rate down ~55% cluster-wide, error budget stabilizing.

alex: confirm rollback plan? If any regressions, run `routectl rollback cfg-1723456789-a` and reopen the agent_exec path.

maria: rollback ready, and I left a short runbook in the patch: steps + metrics to watch. Pushing announcement to status page after we verify for 15m.

laura: CS comms posted to ticket and status page draft ready. Sending to oncall for signoff.

sam: monitoring wall: error % now 1.9 -> trending down. Will watch 5m windows and report back.

incident-bot: Mitigation applied: external_action_exec gated for free-tier; structured output stripped for new free-tier requests; cluster-wide rate limits applied. Monitoring for 30m. :satellite:
